An old tree by the schoolyard.
My name's P. I'm a freshman at Kirameki High.
I never thought I'd get into my first choice, but I got lucky!
This is amazing! I'm at the same school as Fujisaki Shiori, the girl I secretly like.
Actually... We've been friends since elementary school. We live next door, but...
She's way out of my league. So we're still just friends...
Hey. What's with the long face?
Uh, yeah... Nothing... (A bit too friendly...)
I'm Saotome Yoshio. Nice to meet you. What's your name?
I'm P. Nice to meet you too.
Huh? Why are the girls all excited?
Greetings, all. Sorry to keep you waiting.
You all know me, of course... I'm Ijuin Rei, the chairman's grandson.
Tough luck, boys. Anyway... Let's try to get along, shall we?
Ijuin? From that rich family? This class is going to be a pain...
Oh, Shiori's turn to introduce herself.)
Nice to meet you all. I'm Fujisaki Shiori.
My hobby is listening to music, mostly classical. I hope we'll all get along!
S-so cute! Fujisaki Shiori-chan... Glad I'm in this class!
You said you hated this class a minute ago...)
Hey, she looked at you! Do you know her?
Know her? She's my childhood friend.
Huh, really... So, when's her birthday?
She just said she likes listening to music!
H-hey... Your notebook's all about girls...
Got questions about girls? Give me a call. I'll help you out.
Anyway... Have you heard this school's legend?
See that big tree out the window?
If a girl confesses to you under that tree, you'll be happy together forever.
Wow, there's a legend like that?
Don't know who started it, but I'm kinda jealous.
A legend, huh... If it were me...
And so high school began, full of hopes and fears...
